headline: WATCH batch 10: four more games can play themselves
lede: The solver-script family gets the Y key. Zelda, Lemmings-Lite, Momentum Runner and Papers, Please-Min already showed their proven route on the attract screen — now any player can call it up mid-run, watch the game solve itself from wherever it stands, and grab the wheel back with any input.

notes.text: WATCH seats four more proven drivers: Zelda's BFS quest planner, the Lemmings solver (it re-solves the live board and replays its own script to the tick), Momentum Runner's ballistic autopilot, and the perfect inspector of Papers, Please-Min. 47 titles on the shelf now advertise their route.
Every seat declines honestly: if the oracle can't prove a clean finish from exactly where you are, Y does nothing — never a fake demo. Lemmings carries even the terrain damage into the clone it asks.

Found the phase law: Momentum's drones sweep on absolute ticks, so the greedy plan declines about a third of spawn moments (72 ok, 73 no, 74 ok). The seat refuses honestly; a waiting-seat that proves through the bad phase is filed for polish (#1828).

Harness law kept sharp: the mutant drive-off went exactly the two prover gates red, phone/pill tripwires climbed to 47, and pillcheck learned bottom-docked pills — after a stale-transform in the sandbox proved a browser result must be re-checked against the served bytes.

look.text: Press Y in Zelda and watch Hyrule get walked
Let the perfect inspector run the booth
